newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy nearbys drop, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy nearbys drop, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf nearby soybean positions fell on Friday while corn and wheat values steadied, dealers said.
The spread volatility on the Chicago Board of Trade soybeans may have contributed to the drop in FOB soybeans, one dealer said.
Farms sales of both soybeans and corn were slow, he said.
On the export front, Taiwan bought 108,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans. Also, Egypt's official commodities buyer was seeking 50,000-55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for delivery in September and October.

Samir el-Shakankiri, vice chairman of General Authority for Supply Commodities, said the deadline for bids was July 26. Earlier this week, he tendered for an another 50,000 tonnes of French wheat. The deadline is July 27.
Pakistan would be seeking on July 28 a total of 500,000
tonnes optional origin wheat for August 11-Sept 10 shipment.
